description: Response of `POST /mgmt/v1/keys/mirror-sync`: one full keyring mirror reconcile, run now.

deleted_shredded.description: Mirror entries of shredded keys, deleted.

error.description: Why the mirror could not be listed; nothing was backfilled.

failed.description: Pending writes that failed again (they stay pending).

last_full_reconcile_ok_at.description: The last successful full reconcile since the server started.

ok.description: The full listing succeeded and every push and repair went through.

repaired.description: Entries missing in the mirror, written there (keys, `FORMAT`, the ledgers).

unknown.description: Mirror entries that are neither local nor shredded (never deleted).

title: KeysMirrorSyncResponse
